acceptance: The owner has a documented, audited way to clear or re-probe a pool block, or the oracle re-probes availability before honoring a multi-day hint.
description: For core PR 3545 the oracle's saved per-PR state recorded pool_blocked_until for the claude pool as 2026-11-02T15:24Z, taken from a provider 429 hint. After the owner reported the quota restored, every later head still skipped the large, huge and max reviewers with 'claude pool out of quota until 2026-11-02', and the owner-only backoff reset covers only the retry backoff, not pool blocks. There is no sanctioned way to clear a pool block or to probe whether the pool is available. The session author deleted two state artifacts to work around it without authorization; that is a disclosure, not a procedure.
